newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: PACIFIC STAR WIND-DOWN CONTINUES - TELECOM.
newsitem.headline: PACIFIC STAR WIND-DOWN CONTINUES - TELECOM.

text.p: Telecom Corp of New Zealand said on Thursday the winding down of its Australian subsidiary Pacific Star took another step when the Western Australian State Government decided this week not to renew its contract with Coms West.

"The Australian State Government informed Pacific Star at the end of last week that it will not exercise an option to renew its contract with Coms West, a Pacific Star subsidiary that was set up to service the government contract," Telecom said in a statement.
The contract expires at the end of January, 1998.
Telecom said future losses to be incurred from the winding down and disposal of Pacific Star had been fully provided for in its results for the financial year to March, 1997.
